name: backlog
description: Two-way sync between haren tasks and a Backlog.md board
setup: sh -c 'if [ -f backlog/config.yml ] || [ -f backlog/config.yaml ] || [ -f .backlog/config.yml ] || [ -f .backlog/config.yaml ] || [ -f backlog.config.yml ] || [ -f backlog.json ]; then exit 0; fi; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then backlog init "$0" --defaults; else backlog init "$0" --defaults --no-git; fi' '{{project}}'
